Condition : 1 - THAT THE CERTIFICATE OF LAWFULNESS IS GRANTED
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 27th January 2003, the use of one room of the residential property for the operation of a chauffeur business ancillary to the property's use as a single family dwellinghouse is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and  192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The chauffeur business involves only one car and a telephone in one room of the 	house with no internal or external alterations to the property. The scale and nature of the business use is ancillary to the residential use with the property continuing to function as a dwellinghouse. There is no material change of use of part or whole of the dwelling and therefore planning permission is not required.
description: Change of use - Certificate of Lawfulness for the use of one room in dwellinghouse for chauffeur business
